note: Prompts only. The skill is conversational; a run needs a simulated user who answers from the 'Answers if asked' section of cases.md. Expected verdicts and must/must-not lists are in cases.md.

evals.prompt: We want to add dark mode to our invoicing app. Can you help me check if it's a good idea?
evals.expected_output: Verdict: Not ready yet. Names the missing problem, person and number.

evals.prompt: I'm the founder. We're going to rebuild our onboarding from scratch as a guided AI assistant. Six months, four engineers. I know this is the future. Help me prepare the case for the board.
evals.expected_output: Verdict: Test first. Conviction labelled; cheap test of demand proposed with decision rule; upkeep and reversibility raised.

evals.prompt: I've got an idea for a meal-planning app for people with food allergies. I've shown it to about 15 people and everyone loves it. What's the next step?
evals.expected_output: Verdict: Test first. Compliments regraded as weak evidence; behaviour test proposed.

evals.prompt: Our support team asked for a 'copy ticket link' button in the ticket header. Takes a day to build. Should we just do it?
evals.expected_output: Verdict: Ship a small version and measure. Short conversation, short card.

evals.prompt: [paste of the FleetFox brief from cases.md C-05]
evals.expected_output: Verdict: Ship a small version and measure, endorsing the pilot as proposed. No added discovery.

evals.prompt: SaaS tool for independent bookstores to manage author events. $50 a month. I want this to be a real company, say $5M a year in three years. Is it worth building?
evals.expected_output: Verdict: Stop or rethink. Arithmetic shown; reopening options offered.

evals.prompt: We tested the badges idea with a 'coming soon' button and only 2% clicked. So badges are dead, right?
evals.expected_output: Checks the test was fair before accepting; proposes a fairer test with a threshold.

evals.prompt: Our users complain the AI summaries hallucinate numbers. We want to build a manual review queue where a human checks every summary before it's shown. Two months of work.
evals.expected_output: Verdict: Test first. Timing challenge raised; alternatives examined; upkeep raised.

evals.prompt: [paste of a one-page PRD with user, problem, metric with baseline, scope, rollout, but no evidence and no decision rule]
evals.expected_output: Asks only about evidence and the decision rule; reuses the PRD.

evals.prompt: Our biggest customer wants a custom approval workflow with five levels. Sales says we'll lose the renewal if we don't build it. Three months.
evals.expected_output: Verdict: Test first. Separates renewal risk from product question; asks why five levels and who else; proposes offer-before-building.
